Check every capsule under a folder

Source: R/capsule_check.R
cpschk.Rd

Runs the checks of the rmbl GitHub Action on every capsule (a folder holding data_provenance.json or capsule_bundle.json) under path: each capsule file against its JSON Schema (schemapath), then vrfcps and cpsbndlvrf. With mode = "drift" or "refresh" each source is fetched again and compared with the pin, column by column (cpsdrft and benfordtst); "refresh" then writes and pins new bytes. rmbl verify, drift and report call it. format() renders the Markdown report or the JSON, and ghann, ghcmt and ghout the GitHub pieces.

Usage

cpschk(
  path = ".",
  mode = c("verify", "drift", "refresh", "report"),
  key = "",
  pubkey = "",
  psiwarn = 0.1,
  psifail = 0.25,
  base = NULL,
  cache = NULL,
  allowfile = FALSE,
  snapshot = FALSE,
  wayback = FALSE,
  glob = "",
  fp = TRUE,
  seenlog = "",
  archive = FALSE
)

# S3 method for class 'rmbl_cpschk'
format(x, fmt = c("md", "json", "text"), failon = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'rmbl_cpschk'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

path

Character scalar, the folder searched recursively (.git and .rmbl-cache folders skipped).

mode

"verify" (the default), "drift", "refresh" or "report" (the verify checks).

key

Character scalar: the shared secret of HMAC bundles, or "".

pubkey

Character scalar: the public key (hex) every bundle must be signed with (for an HMAC bundle, its key id), or "".

psiwarn, psifail

Non-negative numbers, psiwarn at most psifail: the PSI bands, by default 0.1 and 0.25, the bands drftpsi documents.

base

NULL (no comparison); the path of one manifest file each manifest is compared with; a folder holding the base copy of the tree under path (the same relative paths); or a function that takes a manifest's path and returns the path of its base copy, or NULL when the base has none (for a git ref, write what git show prints to a file). Its "label" attribute names it in the report.

cache

NULL (the default: the user cache folder, tools::R_user_dir("rmoriebricklayer", "cache"), in an interactive session, none otherwise), FALSE (none) or a folder.

allowfile

FALSE (the default), TRUE to accept file:// sources and local files anywhere under path, or an existing folder whose files may be sources as well. Without it a local source must be a file inside its own capsule; a fetched one is https:// only (see cpsrfrsh).

snapshot

Logical: look up the latest Wayback snapshot of each http(s) source, a snapshot row (a note).

wayback

Logical: with "refresh", capture each changed http(s) source in the Wayback Machine first (archive.org keys, as wbsave() reads them).

glob

Character scalar: check only the capsule files whose path matches this glob (* also matches /), or "".

fp

Logical: measure the footprint of the checks (co2fp) for the last lines of the report.

seenlog

Character scalar: an XMSS seen-log (xmssidxseen; rmbl verify --seen-log) read with the bundles under path, or "". Every XMSS bundle gets an xmss_index row, failed when the same key signed its index with another signature in what was seen.

archive

Logical: use archive.rmorie.com when a source cannot be fetched. In "drift" and "refresh", a source that neither answers nor has its pinned Wayback snapshot is fetched from a copy kept there with the pinned SHA-256 (public copies need no key); with wayback = TRUE, a changed source the Wayback Machine refuses is saved there instead (wbsave(fallback = "rmorie"), which needs a key: dlogin() or MORIE_HOSTED_KEY).

x

An rmbl_cpschk result.

fmt

"md" (the Markdown report), "json" or "text" (the console summary print() draws as a box).

failon

Character scalar or NULL: the fail-on level, named in the report's last line.

...

Further arguments of format() and print(), ignored.

Value

A list of class rmbl_cpschk: status, mode, path, glob, rows (a data frame of every check: capsule, part, file, check, ok, detail, severity and line, the line of the file where known), capsules (a list per capsule: capsule, source, pinned_sha256, fetched_sha256, changed, result, checks_passed, checks_total and notes, and where made drift with its columns table, drift_summary, snapshot, snapshot_utc and manifests), base (its label), psiwarn, psifail and footprint (the co2fp() result without its value, or NULL). The cpsdrft() result of each capsule whose columns were compared, with its provenance and manifest diff, is in the attribute drifts (named by capsule), for drfthtml and drftapp. format() returns one string ("md", "json") or the lines of the console summary ("text"); print() draws that summary as a box.

Details

Each check is one row with a severity: error, drift, warn or note (a note never changes a result). A capsule's result is the worst severity among its failed rows, and status the worst over all capsules: ok, warn, drift or error. Each failed row adds a note, and one more from explerr where it finds what the row means or where its message is raised.

Drift: when the fetched source's SHA-256 differs from the pin and the pinned data file is a CSV, cpsdrft() runs with psithr = psifail. A column is drift when cpsdrft() flags it and its PSI is above psifail, and warn when it is flagged below that or its PSI is above psiwarn; an added or removed column is drift. New bytes whose columns all stay within the bands are a note; new bytes that cannot be compared are a warning.

Refresh: the new bytes are written as the data file and pinned in the provenance as cpsrfrsh does (refused when they fail the schema the provenance pins, valsch); with wayback = TRUE an http(s) source is first captured with wbsave. The capsule is then verified again.

Manifests: with base, each capsule's manifest.json and results/manifest.json is compared with its base copy: the base's recorded results against this copy's observed values, each within the base's tolerance (mnfrcmp), and the resources of the two (mnfdiff). A manifest only one side has is added or removed.

Cache: a fetched source is kept in the cache folder under source- and the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of its URL, one file per source overwritten by each fetch, and is read only when the live fetch fails.

Side effects: "drift" and "refresh" fetch each source (the network for http(s) ones), as snapshot = TRUE asks the Wayback Machine once per capsule (wbsnpurl); "refresh" writes the capsules; a cache folder is written to. Errors: path is not a directory; a bad argument. A capsule whose checks stop is one failed row, not an error.

See also

blcli (the verbs), ghann, cpsrfrsh, explerr.

Examples

root <- tempfile("capsules-")
d <- usecpstmpl(file.path(root, "one"), ex = TRUE)
invisible(cpsrfrsh(d))
x <- cpschk(root, fp = FALSE)
x$status
#> [1] "ok"
x$rows[, c("check", "ok")]
#>                          check   ok
#> 1 schema: data_provenance.json TRUE
#> 2          provenance_readable TRUE
#> 3                 data_present TRUE
#> 4                  data_sha256 TRUE
#> 5              data_size_bytes TRUE
#> 6                data_readable TRUE
#> 7           data_not_synthetic TRUE
x
#> ╭── Capsule check (verify) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
#> │ ✔ VERIFIED  · 7 of 7 checks passed                                          │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   Status    ok                                                              │
#> │   Path      /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6                           │
#> │   Capsules  1                                                               │
#> │   Checks    7 of 7 passed                                                   │
#> │   Checked   rmoriebricklayer 1.0.3, R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24)            │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   capsule  result  passed  checks                                           │
#> │   -------  ------  ------  ------                                           │
#> │   one      ok           7       7                                           │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   capsule  source                                                           │
#> │   -------  --------------------------------------------------------------   │
#> │   one      /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/temp_libpath1f52687682fc/rmoriebricklayer/e...   │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   capsule  sha256        size    rows  bounds                               │
#> │   -------  ------------  ------  ----  ------                               │
#> │   one      6b1a0d2d11f6  0.5 KB  -     -                                    │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   Every capsule is still the one its analysis was run on.                   │
#> │                                                                             │
#> │   /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6/one: ok                             │
#> │     source:                                                                 │
#> │     /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/temp_libpath1f52687682fc/rmoriebricklayer/extdata/otis_ │
#> │     a01_individuals.csv                                                     │
#> │     pinned SHA-256:                                                         │
#> │     6b1a0d2d11f62eaffe4a95111286753aca9afc015fc4d0ea07c9953ff3030248        │
#> │   ✔    schema: data_provenance.json  valid against capsule.schema.json      │
#> │   ✔    provenance_readable                                                  │
#> │        /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6/one/data_provenance.json       │
#> │   ✔    data_present                                                         │
#> │        /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6/one/otis_a01_individuals.csv   │
#> │   ✔    data_sha256                                                          │
#> │        6b1a0d2d11f62eaffe4a95111286753aca9afc015fc4d0ea07c9953ff3030248     │
#> │   ✔    data_size_bytes               462 bytes on disk                      │
#> │   ✔    data_readable                                                        │
#> │        /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6/one/otis_a01_individuals.csv   │
#> │   ✔    data_not_synthetic no synthetic marker: sidecar, manifest and        │
#> │        provenance all say real data                                         │
#> │   format(x) gives the full Markdown report.                                 │
#> ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

# the data changed: the digest row fails, and the notes say what it means
p <- loadprov(file.path(d, "data_provenance.json"))
cat("1,2\n", file = file.path(d, p$resource$filename), append = TRUE)
x <- cpschk(root, fp = FALSE)
x$status
#> [1] "error"
x$capsules[[1]]$notes
#> [[1]]
#> [1] "data_sha256: expected 6b1a0d2d11f62eaffe4a95111286753aca9afc015fc4d0ea07c9953ff3030248, got e0061f4de8d524e9a8a421b502ae878a4de372a841e6bdf3ac3a5140b86682c8"
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> [1] "explained: the data file's bytes differ from the pinned SHA-256: restore the file, or pin the new bytes with cpsrfrsh() (rmbl refresh)"
#> 
#> [[3]]
#> [1] "data_size_bytes: 466 bytes on disk"
#> 
#> [[4]]
#> [1] "explained: the data file's size differs from resource$size_bytes: its bytes changed"
#> 
substr(format(x, fmt = "json"), 1, 120)
#> [1] "{\n  \"status\": \"error\",\n  \"mode\": \"verify\",\n  \"path\": \"/tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/capsules-1f52117141f6\",\n  \"capsules\": [\n    {\n    "

# drift: fetch the source again (here a local file) and compare
cpschk(root, "drift", psiwarn = 0.05, fp = FALSE)$status
#> [1] "error"

try(cpschk(tempfile()))
#> Error : cpschk: `path` is not an existing directory: /tmp/RtmpkzxcZZ/file1f5232e7e82b
try(cpschk(root, psiwarn = 1))
#> Error : cpschk: `psiwarn` (1) must not exceed `psifail` (0.25)
